raw_response:
structural program complete
There is no genuinely new, non-vacuous, label-free structural bridge direction still worth deriving inside the current Window6↔codon-Q6 frame.
The reason is that the admissible structural degrees of freedom have been exhausted at the right null level. Once the code is treated as a partition of  $Q_6$ , and the nulls already condition on degeneracy, box/wobble structure, composition, edge margins, boundary degrees, component structure, 2-face motifs, quotient topology, and  $e_{\rm in}$ , any remaining “new invariant” would almost certainly be one of three things:


A disguised  $e_{\rm in}$  statistic.
It would count paths, flows, spectra, curvature, conductance, or higher faces, but its signal would come from the number or placement of synonymous Hamming-1 edges already certified.


A disguised composition statistic.
It would re-encode box structure, wobble class, degeneracy, branch splits, GC-position, or codon-pair geometry under a more abstract name.


A bespoke fingerprint.
Since the code is finite, one can always invent a label-free functional that separates the standard code. But unless the invariant is canonical before seeing the answer and survives the maximally conditioned null, it is numerology.


The closure result is stronger than “we failed to find more.” It says the bridge has a clean terminal shape:

$$\text{Window6 separating endpoint}
\quad \leftrightarrow \quad
\text{genetic-code tolerant endpoint}$$

through the single certified contact  $e_{\rm in}$ , while all other canonical codon-graph structure is typical once the correct controls are imposed.
That is not a weak ending. It is exactly the anti-numerological ending the program needed. The structural result is narrow, falsifiable, and non-inflated: the only real bridge signal is edge-hiding extremality. The non-q6 embedding failures are also important because they prevent retrofitting Window6 into the code through arbitrary encodings.
A possible “next structural direction” would be a theorem of closure rather than a new invariant: prove that, under the chosen conditioned null family, every natural invariant in the cube partition association algebra decomposes into the span of composition terms plus  $e_{\rm in}$  plus null residual. But that is not a new bridge direction. It is a formal consolidation of the closure already observed. It may be valuable for manuscript rigor, but it does not open new science.
So the remaining frontier is empirical/bio:
Does the certified  $e_{\rm in}$  optimum actually buy measurable robustness against mistranslation damage?
The decisive pattern is not merely “the standard code is robust.” The sharp test is mediation:

$$e_{\rm in} \uparrow
\quad \Rightarrow \quad
\text{DMS-weighted one-step mistranslation damage} \downarrow$$

across degeneracy-matched codes, followed by:

$$\text{standard-code advantage disappears or sharply weakens after conditioning on } e_{\rm in}.$$

If that happens, the structural bridge has found its biological mediator. If not, the final claim remains purely combinatorial: a certified tolerance extremality with no demonstrated biological consequence.
The sharpest next question is:
Is the standard code’s experimentally measured mistranslation robustness fully mediated by synonymous edge hiding, or does any residual robustness remain after conditioning on  $e_{\rm in}$ ?
